name: 口语
description: Collins Speaking for IELTS 全 12 单元。覆盖 Part 1/2/3 全部题型技巧，配词汇、语法、发音专项（弱读强读/词重音/长短元音/辅音/schwa/句重音/-ed读音/双元音/连读/不发音字母）。

examInfo.note: 面对面与考官交流，全程录音

sections.desc: Introduction and interview（4–5分钟）：自我介绍 + 日常话题问答
Individual long turn（3–4分钟）：1分钟准备 + 1–2分钟个人陈述
Two-way discussion（4–5分钟）：就 Part 2 话题深入讨论

units.title: People and relationships
units.topic: Family matters / 性格描写与人际关系
examTips: personality 与 relationships 词汇在 Part 1 和 Part 2 都很有用——考到'谈你自己或你认识的人'时直接用。
使用 good range of phrases 谈论人际关系能显著提高得分。
用 character adjective 描述人时，要展开或解释：She's really outgoing – she's always going out with friends and colleagues.
练习使用新学的语言，但不要死记整句；要自发地说出来。
watchOuts: 别忘了给第三人称动词加 -s：he, she, it → She likes cooking.
否定前缀搭配需专门记忆：impatient, disloyal, unreliable（-un-, -dis-, -im-）。

techniques.name: 性格形容词 + 副词修饰
techniques.detail: 正形容词前可用 really / so 修饰；负形容词用 can be a bit + 形容词 弱化；not very + 形容词 更弱化。

examples.en: She's really outgoing.
She can be a bit impatient.
examples.cn: can be a bit 弱化负形容词

examples.en: He's not very reliable.
She's really outgoing – she's always going out with friends and colleagues.

techniques.name: 关系短语
techniques.detail: 掌握描述人际关系的常用短语。

examples.en: I take after my dad – we're both quite careless.
I'm close to my Uncle Jacques.
We grew apart from each other over the years.
I fell out with my best friend.

grammar: 副词修饰形容词：really outgoing, so creative, a bit impatient, not very reliable
第三人称动词加 -s：She likes cooking.
否定前缀：impatient (im-), disloyal (dis-), unreliable (un-)
I consider myself to be... / I would say I was...
units.pronunciation: Weak and strong forms（弱读与强读）：形容词重读、副词弱读
exercises: 15个性格形容词 + 释义配对
Part 1 样题：Tell me something about your family.

units.title: A healthy body
units.topic: Health and fitness / 运动与健康饮食
examTips: Watch your favourite sport with commentary in English. 仔细听并记下有用的词与短语。
Planning your answer (Part 2)：先读题、用1分钟准备时间列出要点，再展开说。
watchOuts: 用球类运动/团体运动时不要用 'non-team sport' 的动词：I don't do any sports (不是 I don't practise any sports)。常用搭配：I go swimming.

techniques.name: 谈论运动的感受词
techniques.detail: 用不同形容词表达对观看/参与运动的感受。

examples.en: Watching sport is tedious / entertaining / all right if there's nothing else on TV.
Playing sports is exhilarating / good fun / exhausting / a great way to keep fit.
I'm quite into sport / fanatical about sport / not the least bit interested in sport.

techniques.name: 健康与饮食词汇
techniques.detail: 区分 diet 的两个含义；掌握 malnutrition / metabolism / carbohydrates / vitamins / calories 等核心词。

examples.en: I plan to go on a diet in the new year.
I think I have a balanced diet.
Athletes eat carbohydrates before a race because they give their bodies lots of energy.
There are some people who have a fast metabolism.

techniques.name: Tennis 主题卡（Part 2 示范）
techniques.detail: 完整回答框架：Where / Equipment / Important event / Terminology / Useful phrases / Why。

examples.en: It's a battle of the mind as much as the body.
He's served an ace. / It's gone to a tie-break. / What a great shot!

grammar: 表达观点句型：I don't really enjoy X because..., I find it really hard to..., What I like about X is...
Part 2 框架：what → when & where → who with → why it matters
units.pronunciation: Expressing enthusiasm（表达热情）：语调、重音与语速变化
exercises: Tennis 主题卡完整内容填写
讨论题：Would you say you have a balanced diet?

units.title: Studies and work
units.topic: Education and work / 推测句式
examTips: Learn the words for the job you do, the job you would most like to do, the most difficult, the most rewarding, and the most prestigious.
Make sure you can pronounce the jobs correctly.
Practice talking about the jobs and explaining something about them.
watchOuts: 给工作头衔时别忘了冠词（a, an, the）：I'm a nurse. / She's the managing director.

techniques.name: 工作词汇完整库
techniques.detail: 掌握19个工作相关核心词汇及词形变化。

examples.en: I'm self-employed. Nobody can fire me because I'm my own boss.
I'm a bit of a workaholic. I'm constantly doing overtime.
I'm the main breadwinner in my family.
Lots of workers are being laid off at the moment.

techniques.name: 推测句式（Speculating）
techniques.detail: 谈论工作时用推测句式：I'd imagine / I'd say / I suppose / He must be / He can't be / 条件句。

examples.en: I'd imagine he earns a lot.
He must be very stressed.
He can't be very happy with that salary.
If I were you, I'd look for a job with better job security.

grammar: 推测句式：I'd imagine / I'd say / I suppose
情态动词推测：He must be / He can't be
条件句：If I were you, I'd... / If he got the job, he would probably...
词形变化：employ→employment, promote→promotion, lay off→laid off
exercises: Part 1 答题：相关 + 长度合适（1–3句）

units.title: The world around us
units.topic: Nature and the environment / 环境与气候
examTips: Lexical resource（= range of vocabulary）makes up 25% of your mark in the exam. 词汇量占分25%。
如果你没有做过某事，就说你认为哪些最有效、为什么。
watchOuts: 常见错误：把 it's 留在句子里。It's always windy. 正确读作 /ɪts/ always windy.

techniques.name: 环保行动词汇
techniques.detail: 掌握7个核心环保动词及句型模板。

examples.en: Recycle paper, cans, plastic, glass and other items like batteries.
I try to reduce my carbon footprint by walking everywhere.
Switch to a green energy supplier.
Boycott products that harm the environment.

techniques.name: 气候描述表达
techniques.detail: 用 get / tends to be 描述天气。

examples.en: We often get thick fog. (get = have)
In the winter, it gets absolutely freezing. (gets = becomes)
In the summer, it tends to be hot. (tends to be = is usually)

techniques.name: Cleft sentences（强调句式）
techniques.detail: 用 It was...that... / What I want is... / The thing I hate most is... 强调信息。

examples.en: It was in the spring that we moved here.
What I want is more time.
It's the government that should take responsibility.

grammar: Cleft sentences（强调句式）：It was...that... / What I want is...
Complex sentences：Although it's expensive, it's worth it.
Subordinate clauses：although, because, while, when, if, since, as, whereas, so that, in order to
get 的三个含义：have / becomes / reaches；tend to be = is usually
connectors: 从属连词：although, because, while, when, if, since, as, whereas, so that, in order to
units.pronunciation: Long and short vowel sounds（长短元音）：ship/sheep, bit/bitten, full/fool
exercises: get 与 tend to be 语法练习
Part 1 答题 + 用新闻报道积累 Part 3 观点

units.title: Communication
units.topic: Language and communication / 语言学习与全球化
examTips: Giving yourself time to think：用 Well,... / That's an interesting question. 争取思考时间。
Agreeing and disagreeing with the examiner：Part 3 讨论中要用，但要礼貌。

techniques.name: 语言水平表述
techniques.detail: 掌握 mother tongue / multilingual / fluent / basic / rusty / pick up 等核心表达。

examples.en: My mother tongue is Mandarin.
I'm fluent in English.
My French is a bit rusty.
I picked up some Japanese when I lived there.

techniques.name: 全球化词形变化
techniques.detail: 掌握 integrate→integration, common→commonly, technology→technological 等派生。

examples.en: The integration of the world's economies is commonly known as globalisation.
This is largely due to technological advances.

techniques.name: 表达态度（Agreeing/Disagreeing）
techniques.detail: 礼貌地表达同意与不同意。

examples.en: Absolutely. / I couldn't agree more. / That's a good point.
I see what you mean, but... / I'm afraid I disagree. / Up to a point.
Not really. / I don't think so.

grammar: 比较级规则：单音节加 -er/-est；双音节 -y 结尾用 -er/-est；-ing/-ed/-al/-ful/-ive/-less/-ous 用 more/most
不规则：good(better,best), bad(worse,worst), far(further,furthest)
三音节及以上用 more/most
词形变化（后缀）：-ity, -tion
connectors: 态度表达：Absolutely / I couldn't agree more / That's a good point / I see what you mean, but... / I'm afraid I disagree / Up to a point / Not really
观点句型：In my opinion... / I'd say that... / The main advantage of... is that...
units.pronunciation: Consonants（辅音）：/θ/ vs /s/, /w/ vs /v/, /l/ vs /r/, 清浊辅音对立
exercises: 全球化词形变化填空（10空）

units.title: Technology
units.topic: Science and technology / 科技与互联网
watchOuts: 许多 phrasal verbs 有多个含义。
猜测 phrasal verbs 的含义很难——学习这些粒子的一般含义会有帮助。

techniques.name: 科技词汇与态度
techniques.detail: 区分 technophile / technophobe；掌握 cutting-edge / state-of-the-art / outdated。

examples.en: Technophiles love gadgets and all that is state-of-the-art.
cutting-edge 的同义词 → state-of-the-art
cutting-edge 的反义词 → outdated

techniques.name: Phrasal verbs 一词两义
techniques.detail: 掌握 break down / turn up / turn down / blow up / set off / turn over 的多重含义。

examples.en: They broke down the bridge. (demolished)
Talks broke down. (failed)
Can you turn up the heating? (increase)
I'm going to turn it down. (reject)

techniques.name: 互联网四大危险
techniques.detail: identity theft / viruses / cyber bullying / Internet addiction。

examples.en: identity theft: criminals steal your personal details
cyber bullying: harassed, threatened or humiliated over the Internet
Internet addiction: excessive use that interferes with daily life

grammar: Phrasal verb particles：up=increase, down=reduce, on=start/continue, off=stop/separate/start, in=put into, out=depart, away=avoid
频率表达：every other day, once a week
connectors: Coherence 连接手段：First of all, In addition, However, On the other hand, As a result, To sum up, For example, That's why...
units.pronunciation: Sentence stress（句子重音）：实义词重读，虚词弱读
exercises: Phrasal verbs 一词两义配对（6组×2义）
Phrasal verb particles 表格填空

units.title: Hobbies
units.topic: Employment and finances / 表达好恶与频率
examTips: 准备好谈论自己的业余爱好以及做这些活动的频率。
用短语表达频率而不是只用单个词，能提高考试表现。
Part 1 不要只说一句或一个短语就不说了。

techniques.name: 表达好恶的短语
techniques.detail: 区分 positive / negative / neutral 态度。

examples.en: I'm keen on photography. (positive)
I can't stand board games. (negative)
I don't mind cooking. (neutral)
I can take it or leave it. (neutral)

techniques.name: 爱好相关短语（阅读/艺术/音乐/电影）
techniques.detail: page-turner / exhibition / taken up / genre / mixed reviews 等。

examples.en: It's a real page-turner. I just can't put it down.
I've just taken up the piano.
What I like about them is their thoughtful lyrics and catchy tunes.
My favourite film genre is comedy.

techniques.name: 频率表达排序
techniques.detail: 从低到高：several times a year → twice a year → once a fortnight → every other day → every Tuesday → every single day。

examples.en: I sing karaoke every other Saturday.
I go to the theatre about three times a year.

grammar: Present perfect：have/has + p.p.，表过去发生对现在有影响
Present perfect simple vs continuous：simple 强调结果/完成；continuous 强调持续/过程
对比：I've been reading this book for a week.（还在读）vs I've read this book.（读完了）
units.pronunciation: The schwa /ə/：非重读音节中的弱读央元音
exercises: 好恶句型 + 情感判断（7句）
Present perfect vs continuous 练习
Part 1 答题 + 请考官重复问题 / 礼貌表达

units.title: Youth
units.topic: Childhood / 童年回忆与过去习惯

techniques.name: 回忆短语
techniques.detail: 掌握12个回忆相关短语及同义改写。

examples.en: It really takes me back.
The memories are so vivid.
It's still fresh in my mind.
The name escapes me. / It's on the tip of my tongue!
It all comes flooding back.
Time flies!

techniques.name: 童年相关表达（含 child 的词）
techniques.detail: latchkey child / only child / child benefit / child labour / child's play / child-friendly / childish 等。

examples.en: I bump into my childhood friends occasionally.
She's an only child.
That exam was easy. In fact, it was child's play.
He's a latchkey child – he arrives home to an empty house.

techniques.name: used to vs would
techniques.detail: used to 可表状态和重复动作；would 只表重复动作，不表状态。

examples.en: I used to be very shy. (状态)
I would go to the beach every summer. (重复动作)
My grandmother would tell us stories all the time.

vocab: on the tip of my tongue
grammar: used to + 动词原形：表过去状态/习惯
would + 动词原形：只表过去重复动作，不表状态
used to vs would：状态只用 used to；重复动作两者皆可
过去时复习：规则-ed/不规则；过去进行时 was/were + -ing；过去完成时 had + p.p.
units.pronunciation: Past tense -ed endings（三种读音）：/t/（清辅音后）/d/（浊辅音后）/ɪd/（/t//d/后）；Diphthongs（双元音）
exercises: 回忆短语听写填空（12空，3段文本）
含 child 的词填空（9题）

units.title: Home
units.topic: People and places / 描述地点与住宅
examTips: 谈论家乡时可以说些负面内容，但最好以积极的方式呈现自己。
Suffixes（后缀）可让你从已掌握的词造出新词：-ity, -ence/-ance, -tion/-sion, -age, -y, -ant。
watchOuts: 英式英语和美式英语有很多差别，例如 flat（英式）vs apartment（美式）。两种英语形式在考试中都接受。

techniques.name: 描述地点词汇
techniques.detail: 区分城市/乡村特征；掌握 cosmopolitan / picturesque / congested / outskirts 等。

examples.en: My village is in the middle of nowhere. It's a real backwater.
The city I live in is very cosmopolitan.
It's a real tourist destination. Sadly, it's also pretty polluted and congested.
I live on the outskirts of a town.

techniques.name: Comparing past and present
techniques.detail: 过去用过去时，现在用现在时/现在完成时；用 used to... now... 对比。

examples.en: Then, this was a nice place to live. Everyone knew everyone.
Now, the population has risen dramatically.
Many of the old factories have been converted into flats.

techniques.name: 被动语态与使役结构
techniques.detail: be + p.p.；make/let + 宾语 + 动词原形；have/get + 宾语 + p.p.。

examples.en: Many of the old factories have been converted into flats.
I've had my roof repaired.
I got him to help me.
examples.cn: 使役：get + 宾语 + to do

grammar: 过去时 vs 现在时/现在完成时（描述变化）
后缀与构词：-ness, -ee, -ism, -hood, -ment, -ship, -ence/-ance, -tion/-sion, -age, -y, -ity
被动语态：be + p.p.（各时态）
使役结构：make/let + 宾语 + 原形；have/get + 宾语 + p.p.；get + 宾语 + to do
connectors: 澄清：Do you mean...? / Sorry, could you be more specific?
释义：In other words,... / What I mean is...
举例：For example,... / For instance,... / Take... for instance.
units.pronunciation: Silent letters（不发音字母）：k in know, w in write, b in climb, gh in night, l in walk, t in listen, h in hour
exercises: Comparing past and present 填空（3段文本）
被动语态与使役结构练习
Part 1 答题 + 澄清/释义/举例

units.title: Culture
units.topic: Culture and modern society / 节庆、历史遗址与遗产
watchOuts: 正确使用介词短语：in July, in the afternoon, at night；日期用序数词：the thirty-first of May。

techniques.name: 节庆与庆祝词汇
techniques.detail: day off / celebrations / street parties / national anthem / banners / marks / anniversary。

examples.en: The 20th of May marks the anniversary of when our King came to the throne.
Everyone is given the day off and people arrange street parties.
At night, fireworks are set off.

techniques.name: 历史遗址与遗产词汇
techniques.detail: excavation / remains / unearthed / artefacts / heritage / listed building 等。

examples.en: An archaeologist announced that he had found the remains of Bronze Age roundhouses.
They had also found a large number of artefacts.
The finds will be exhibited in my local museum.
It's a listed building, protected by law.

techniques.name: 连读规则（Linking）
techniques.detail: 辅音+元音不停顿；元音间加 /j/ 或 /w/；r/re+元音加 /r/。

examples.en: an English → /ən j ɪŋ/
go on → /ɡəʊ w ɒn/
far away → /fɑːr əˈweɪ/

grammar: Future forms：will（预测/承诺）/ be going to（计划）/ be + -ing（已安排）/ present simple（固定时间表）/ may/might（可能）/ should（建议）/ would like to（想要）/ be about to（即将）/ be due to（预定）
units.pronunciation: Linking（连读）：辅音+元音不停顿；元音间加 /j/ /w/；r/re+元音加 /r/
exercises: Part 1 答题 + 预测可能问题

units.title: On the move
units.topic: Holidays and travel / 假期类型与旅游影响
examTips: 当考官问 yes/no 问题时，可以用简短回答开头。只说 yes 或 no 会显得突兀。
正确使用简短回答也是展示你英语水平的一种方式。
watchOuts: 不要在 Yes/No 答案中使用 contracted forms（如 Yes, they're）：应该用 Yes, they are.

techniques.name: 假期类型词汇
techniques.detail: package deal / backpacking / rough it / holiday home / last-minute deal / self-catering。

examples.en: Did you get a package deal? — No, we booked our flights and accommodation separately.
I don't want to rough it anymore!
We're going to try and get a last-minute deal.

techniques.name: 旅游影响（EC/ENV/LP）
techniques.detail: 区分经济(EC)/环境(ENV)/当地生活(LP)影响及正负面。

examples.en: Tourism can bring higher levels of employment. (EC, positive)
Hotels are built on previously unspoilt beaches. (ENV, negative)
Jobs in tourism are often low paid and seasonal. (LP, negative)

techniques.name: 简短回答规则（Short answers）
techniques.detail: Yes + subject + auxiliary/be；可用其他词加强；No 用缩略形式。

examples.en: Do you enjoy going on holiday with your parents? — Yes, I do.
Yes, I certainly do.
Would you recommend it? — Without a doubt.
Did you enjoy that holiday? — I didn't, no.

techniques.name: 间接表达与因果
techniques.detail: 避免过于直接；用 because/due to/so/therefore 表因果。

examples.en: I'm afraid I'd have to disagree.
It depends on...
Since tourism creates jobs, it helps the local economy.

grammar: Short answers：Yes + subject + auxiliary/be；No 用缩略形式
间接表达：I don't think so / I'm afraid I'd have to disagree / That's a fair point, but... / It depends on...
Cause and effect：because / because of / due to / owing to / so / therefore / as a result / consequently / since / as
connectors: 因果：because, because of, due to, owing to, so, therefore, as a result, consequently, that's why, since, as
间接表达：I don't think so / I'm afraid I'd have to disagree / That's a fair point, but... / It depends on...
units.pronunciation: Adding emphasis（强调）：通过重音和语调强调关键词；使用 absolutely, definitely, certainly, particularly, especially
exercises: 假期活动句型模板练习
旅游影响判断（EC/ENV/LP + 正负面，8题）
Short answers 规则练习（6 rules）
间接表达与因果句型练习
Part 1 答题：简短回答 + 扩展细节

units.title: Practice exam
units.topic: 综合模拟（Part 1/2/3 完整流程）

examInfo.title: 考试结构
points: Part 2: Individual long turn — 3–4 minutes（1分钟准备 + 1–2分钟陈述）

examTips: Part 2 后考官会就同一话题再问 1–2 个问题。
Part 3 是与考官的双向讨论——不只是回答，还要提出理由、例子、比较、给出建议。

techniques.name: Part 2 任务卡框架
techniques.detail: Describe a personal achievement you are proud of: what → when → what was difficult → why proud。

examples.en: what you achieved
when you achieved it
what was difficult about achieving it
and explain why you are proud of this achievement

techniques.name: Exam tutor 自我检测清单
techniques.detail: 8项核心自测要点。

examples.en: Part 1：准备3–4个高频话题（家/工作与学习/爱好/家乡/旅行），每话题准备5–8个词块与例句
Part 2 框架公式：what → when/where → who with → why it matters / what was difficult
Part 3：做到双向讨论——提出理由、例子、比较、给出建议
时态：讲过去经历用过去时，讲现在用现在时，讲变化用 used to… now…
